Currently, following families supported: family=c('NOleft_parenthesisright_parenthesis', 'NO2left_parenthesisright_parenthesis', 'BCCGleft_parenthesisright_parenthesis', 'BCPEleft_parenthesisright_parenthesis'). data character string specifying data.frame object holding data analysed specified model. mu.fix Logical, indicating whether mu parameter kept fixed fitting processes.
